definition_zh: 喧闹混乱的场面；疯人院
definition_en: a scene of wild uproar and confusion; historically, a madhouse
core_image: 股市崩盘时的大厅：人人喊叫，纸片乱飞
scene: 开市铃一响，大厅里人声鼎沸、一片混乱。The trading floor became utter bedlam within seconds.
sceneCN: 这里 bedlam 是「喧闹混乱的场面」（第 1 个义项：极度嘈杂与混乱）；句意是交易大厅几秒内乱作一团。

derivatives.zh: 由 bedlam 加 -ite 构成，义为「疯人院里的疯人」（旧式用法）
bedlam 的词源原名，希伯来语地名，义为「粮屋」；今医院名为 Bethlem Royal Hospital

senses.title: Wild uproar and confusion
senses.definition: a place or situation of extreme noise and disorder
senses.definitionCN: 极度嘈杂与混乱的地方或场面
senses.example: The trading floor became utter bedlam within seconds.
senses.exampleCN: 交易大厅几秒内乱作一团。
senses.why: Visitors once flocked to gawk at the asylum's chaos, so the name spread to any uproar.
senses.whyCN: 昔日人们曾蜂拥围观疯人院的混乱，于是院名泛化为一切喧嚣。

senses.title: A madhouse
senses.definition: a hospital or asylum for the mentally ill, in historical use
senses.definitionCN: 收容精神病患的医院或院所（历史用法）
senses.example: In old London, Bedlam stood where the museum stands today.
senses.exampleCN: 在旧伦敦，伯利恒疯人院就坐落在今天博物馆的位置。
senses.why: The word is a worn-down form of Bethlehem, the asylum's name.
senses.whyCN: 该词是 Bethlehem（伯利恒，疯人院之名）的音讹缩略。

intro.en: Bedlam is London's Hospital of Bethlehem worn smooth by speech.
intro.cn: bedlam 是伦敦伯利恒医院之名在口语中磨损而成。

items.cn: 希伯来语 Bethlehem 意为「粮屋」。

items.en: the London priory of St Mary of Bethlehem housed the insane by the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 十四世纪起伦敦伯利恒圣母修道院收容精神病人。

items.en: the hospital's name was pronounced Bedlam in common speech.
items.cn: 十五至十六世纪院名在日常口语中读作 Bedlam。

items.en: visiting the asylum became a public spectacle.
items.cn: 十七世纪参观疯人院成为公开的猎奇活动。

items.en: bedlam now means any uproarious scene, and the hospital is properly Bethlem Royal Hospital.
items.cn: 如今 bedlam 泛指喧闹场面；该医院现名 Bethlem Royal Hospital。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bed- spelling; the near-meaning group gathers uproar words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bed- 拼写；近义组汇集喧嚣类词。

entries.definition: the solid rock beneath soil; the foundation
entries.definitionCN: 基岩；基础——只是拼写相近，词义几近相反的秩序感
暴力混乱——与 bedlam 押韵的近音词

entries.definition: the town of Jesus's birth; the asylum's original name
entries.definitionCN: 伯利恒——bedlam 的词源原名
一片哗然；强调群魔乱舞般的混乱

normalIntro.en: Bedlam was the hospital of Bethlehem, said fast.
normalIntro.cn: bedlam 是 Bethlehem 医院念快了的样子。

normal.en: Bethlehem hospital became Bedlam in speech.
normal.cn: Bethlehem 医院在口语中变成 Bedlam。

normal.en: Visitors once paid to watch the patients.
normal.cn: 昔日参观者付费围观病人。

normal.en: Utter bedlam is the common phrase.
The modern hospital is Bethlem Royal Hospital.
normal.cn: 该医院现名 Bethlem Royal Hospital。

normal.en: Bedlamite was an old word for an inmate.
normal.cn: bedlamite 是旧时指疯人的词。

abstract.en: Hear a thousand voices crash at once.
abstract.cn: 听千百个声音同时炸响。

abstract.en: See papers and elbows flying in a panic.
abstract.cn: 看纸片与手肘在慌乱中翻飞。

abstract.en: Feel the moment the bell rings and order dies.
abstract.cn: 感受铃声一响秩序即灭的瞬间。

examples.en: The trading floor became utter bedlam within seconds.
examples.cn: 交易大厅几秒内乱作一团。

examples.en: In old London, Bedlam stood where the museum stands today.
examples.cn: 在旧伦敦，伯利恒疯人院就坐落在今天博物馆的位置。

examples.en: The classroom dissolved into bedlam when the fire drill sounded.
examples.cn: 消防演习铃一响，教室顿时乱作一团。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奔疯了」——人人都奔逃发疯的场面，正是喧闹混乱的 bedlam（谐音仅为助记，实际源自 Bethlehem）。

root: bedlam 是伦敦伯利恒医院（St Mary of Bethlehem，今 Bethlem Royal Hospital）院名的口语音讹；Bethlehem 源自希伯来语，意为「粮屋」。因旧时公众可围观院内疯人，院名于十七世纪泛化为「混乱喧嚣」的普通名词。

sensesIntro.en: One hospital's name became the word for chaos everywhere.
sensesIntro.cn: 一家医院的名字，成了天下混乱的代名词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hall where every voice shouts at once.
core.cn: 核心意象：人人齐声喊叫的大厅。

intro.en: Bedlam grew from a place name, not from prefixes or roots.
intro.cn: bedlam 由专名讹变而来，并非前缀词根构成。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the source is Hebrew via the hospital name.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，源头是经医院名传入的希伯来语地名。

items.meaning: an inmate of the old asylum
a place of refuge, historically for the insane

derivatives.zh: 由 bedlam 加 -ite 构成，义为「疯人院里的疯人」（旧式用法）
由 bedlam 加 -ical 构成的罕用形容词，义为「疯乱的」
